summary: Phase 2 DHL PNG Demo — comprehensive backend + frontend testing. Backend: 19/19 pytest tests passing in /app/backend/tests/test_shipments_api.py (public scrubbed /track, list pagination + status filter + search, detail with full PII, auth gating, 404 handling, regression auth tests). Frontend: all Phase 2 flows verified including logout-bug-fix, /track public page, scrubbed PII view, invalid AWB empty state, demo button auto-track, /dashboard/shipments list with search/status/reset/pagination, detail with PII + action buttons + back link + demo badge, landing navbar TRACK link, landing hero widget, dashboard Active KPI=15, dashboard recent shipments count=5, sidebar My Shipments link. No critical bugs found.
critical_code_review_comments: shipments_module.py is well-factored — privacy scrub via _scrub_for_public() correctly removes name/company/address/phone/email/postalCode, package details (dimensions/description/declaredValueUSD), costPGK, and userId. Verified via test_public_track_demo_awb_returns_scrubbed.
ShipmentPublic.package is typed as dict; consider a PackagePublicModel with explicit pieces+weightKg for stronger typing. Non-blocking.
Auth gating verified: /api/shipments and /api/shipments/{awb} return 401 without Bearer; /api/track/{awb} works without auth.
Status filter is case-insensitive on backend (status.upper()) — works with lowercase too.
_id correctly stripped from responses; ObjectId never leaks.
Logout fix verified: handleLogout in DashboardLayout.jsx now navigates to '/' BEFORE awaiting logout(), so ProtectedRoute does not interject /login.
Frontend correctly maps recent shipments on /dashboard with testid 'recent-row-{awb}' (5 visible), and main list page on /dashboard/shipments with testid 'shipment-row-{awb}'.

success_rate.backend: 100% (19/19) — plus prior 16/16 auth tests still passing
success_rate.frontend: 100% on all tested critical flows for Phase 2
